verdict.rationale: A government tax and customs portal could plausibly offer a natural-language assistant or command interface, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows one. The items describe ordinary web services: notifications, communication channels, clarifications on tax obligations, login and accessibility mode. The llms.txt probe returned 404, so no agent-oriented docs index is published either.
